name: automobile-showroom-management-system
description: Apex Motors - Automobile Showroom Management System (Pure Static HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JS)

scripts.dev: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const mime = {'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png'}; http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join(process.cwd(), req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) p = path.join(p, 'index.html'); if (!fs.existsSync(p)) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Not Found'); } const ext = path.extname(p); res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': mime[ext] || 'text/plain' }); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(3000, '0.0.0.0', () => console.log('Serving static files on http://0.0.0.0:3000'));"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Pure static site: ready for zero-config Vercel deployment')"
